internal_validation_design.primary: bootstrap optimism correction (Harrell), the ENTIRE pipeline repeated inside every replicate
internal_validation_design.external_validation: NONE -- no suitable confirmatory cohort exists (Phase 4 G4 FAILED). No analysis here is external validation.

resampling_unit.unit: the PATIENT (one array per patient in S3)
resampling_unit.justification: Phase 8B established 0 declared dependent arrays in S3 (dependancy_sample), so array and patient coincide here

stratification.bootstrap: stratified by EVENT STATUS, so every replicate carries a comparable number of events
stratification.outcome_blindness_note: stratifying by event status REQUIRES the outcome and is therefore a MODEL-FITTING-TIME operation. It is specified here and executed only in Phase 9 execution; no fold used in Phases 8A-8C was outcome-stratified, and those folds were explicitly labelled illustrative
stratification.why_not: stratifying on a confounded covariate would make the replicates unrepresentative of the cohort the estimand refers to

hyperparameter_tuning.boundary: inner cross-validation INSIDE each training fold / bootstrap replicate; never on held-out data, never on the full cohort

monte_carlo_stability.rules: MC-1 running trace; MC-2 >=5 seeds; MC-3 MC-SE <= 10% of sampling SE; MC-4 report MC-SE alongside every corrected estimate
monte_carlo_stability.B_rule: B increases (1000, 2000, ...) until MC-3 passes; it is NEVER lowered to suit a result

seed_policy.rule: seeds are declared HERE, before execution, and are never changed after seeing a result. The MC-2 spread across these five seeds IS the Monte-Carlo SE.
seed_policy.note: 20261102 is the project seed already used by Phases 8A-8C

monte_carlo_vs_sampling_uncertainty.sampling_SE: uncertainty from having 453 patients rather than infinitely many; estimated by the bootstrap distribution itself; does NOT shrink with more replicates
monte_carlo_vs_sampling_uncertainty.monte_carlo_SE: uncertainty from having run B replicates rather than infinitely many; estimated as the SD of the corrected estimate across the 5 declared seeds; DOES shrink as B increases, roughly as 1/sqrt(B)
monte_carlo_vs_sampling_uncertainty.reporting_rule: both are reported for every corrected estimate, labelled separately. They are never summed into one interval and never conflated.

procedure: 1. fit the ENTIRE pipeline on the original sample; record apparent performance P_app

2. for b = 1..B: draw a bootstrap sample (stratified by event status), refit the ENTIRE pipeline on it -- including scoring parameters, any score standardisation, filtering, selection and tuning -- and record P_boot(b) on the bootstrap sample and P_orig(b) on the ORIGINAL sample using the bootstrap-fitted model
optimism_correction.reported_together: apparent performance, mean optimism, and corrected performance are reported TOGETHER. Apparent performance is never reported alone (6B §5).
optimism_correction.shrinkage: a uniform shrinkage factor is estimated from the bootstrap and reported whether or not it is applied

convergence_criteria.separation_sentinel: any |beta| > 10 or SE > 10 flags the fit

convergence_and_non_estimable_replicates.recording_rule: every replicate that fails to converge, hits the iteration cap, trips the separation sentinel, or cannot be fitted (rank-deficient design, undefined scaling) is RECORDED with its seed, replicate index and failure reason in a per-model replicate log.
convergence_and_non_estimable_replicates.exclusion_rule: a non-estimable replicate is EXCLUDED from the optimism average and COUNTED. The count and percentage are reported beside every corrected estimate.
convergence_and_non_estimable_replicates.pre_registered_threshold: if more than 5% of replicates for a model are non-estimable, the corrected estimate for that model is reported as UNRELIABLE and the failure pattern is described. Replicates are never silently re-drawn to replace failures, which would bias the optimism estimate toward well-behaved samples.

tuning_nesting.structure: inner cross-validation INSIDE each bootstrap replicate / outer training fold
tuning_nesting.what_is_never_tuned_outside: no hyperparameter is ever selected using held-out data or the full cohort
tuning_nesting.score_standardisation_if_approved: recomputed inside the INNER loop too, not only the outer split

quantities_estimated: calibration slope on the LOG-HAZARD scale (unit-free)
delta-C vs M1 with CI and MC-SE
uniform shrinkage factor (reported whether or not applied)
effective degrees of freedom for penalised fits
quantities_NOT_estimated: t-year / fixed-horizon absolute risk (blocked by U1)
predicted survival or CIF curves (blocked by U1)
time-dependent AUC or Brier score (blocked by U1)
cloglog calibration at a horizon, i.e. Riley's estimator (blocked by U1)

phase5_status.statement: The Phase 5 simulation is an APPROXIMATION of the Riley et al. (2022) external-validation sample-size framework, NOT a faithful implementation of it. The ~338-event figure is an approximation and was explicitly NOT a cross-check of Riley's published ~365.
